policy: Uniform random choices conditional on actual options; exact expectations when possible. Scorer-specific reference values are not interchangeable chance percentages. No model/API calls.

primary.label: Random whole-case guesses
primary.explanation: Mean probability that every field in a case is correct under independent uniform guesses; multiply field probabilities within each case, then average cases. This is not the per-field chance rate.

primary.label: Random ranking
primary.explanation: Expected nDCG@10 under a uniform random permutation of the same scored candidate pool. Uses the original full relevance judgments for the denominator. Missing relevant candidates constrain the best achievable score.

primary.label: Uniform random choice
primary.explanation: Average accepted-answer count / option count across the actual sampled fields. Includes all tied correct moves/statements where the scorer accepts ties; variable option counts are averaged case by case.

Uniform independent choice among each field's actual options, scored with the same F1 definition and observed/predicted label union as the model. F1 is nonlinear and class-frequency dependent; 1/K is not its expected value. This simulation error is not uncertainty in model quality.

primary.label: Always predict p = 0.5
primary.explanation: Binary Brier loss: 0 is perfect and 1 is maximally wrong. Reporting probability0.5 for every event always scores0.25. This is an uninformative probability forecast, not a random hard yes/no guess (whose expected Brier loss is0.5).
